preflight.operatorBaselineDescription: quiet Auto, full-brightness static green, no red/sleep, HyperBoost inactive; USB and 12 V connected

sequenceEvidenceLimit: The private typed supervisor result retains accepted stages and a diagnostic READ of raw0000 at the fresh intermediate query. That READ was rejected as a continuation candidate, not recorded as an accepted DONE. Reviewed source establishes five performed logical exchanges and no further writes. This is not an independently sniffed native packet trace or packet count.

productionAdmission.reason: The attended USB-only boundary was observed while 12 V retention was operator provenance. After reconnect the operator still observed Medium with green lighting unchanged. A fresh admitted query returned raw0000 instead of the required raw0300, so the trial stopped before Auto or raw-mode restoration. Matching the original raw0000 does not establish return to the quiet physical baseline or ownership handback. The overall trial failed. A separate operator-reported full USB-and-12-V power cycle returned to Medium with the same lighting, without recovering the preferred quiet baseline. No production support or causal USB reset claim follows.

limitations: The hash and length identify a private typed supervisor result, not PCAP or an independently retained native report trace.

USB absence was observed for 5113.7454 milliseconds with nominal 250-millisecond polling. Enumeration does not prove continuous absence between samples or electrical power state. Same pad, same port and retained 12 V are operator provenance; fresh native admission supplies exact identity only after reconnect.

No immediate post-Fixed query was performed before USB removal. Raw0300 was last confirmed before the Fixed write; raw0000 was first observed by the fresh query after reconnect. These observations do not establish that USB removal caused a raw-state reset.
The boundary observation completed, but conditional restoration did not. No Auto write, raw-mode restore write, reacquisition, retry or autonomous cleanup followed the rejected raw0000 read.

The original quiet Auto physical baseline remained the restoration target. Observed Medium after reconnect and matching raw0000 do not establish physical restoration, RPM, independent fan state, ownership or handback.

Operator record timestamps are journal-save bookkeeping and may follow supervisor completion; they are not YES submission timestamps. The result proves the post-reconnect physical Medium confirmation was accepted before the failed fresh query.

No Synapse, service action or full power cycle occurred during the trial. A subsequent manual USB-and-12-V power cycle was operator-reported separately as returning to Medium with the same lighting. The preferred quiet baseline was not recovered, no Synapse or service restart was reported, and no post-cycle raw-state query had been performed at this observation.
No crash, forced termination, sleep or vendor handback was tested. No relevant hardware child process or active Razer service remained in the recorded post-trial inventory.
Private paths, process identifiers, nonces, serials, device-instance suffixes, module identifiers and raw native reports are excluded. BIOS is provenance only and imposes no admission gate.
